task: WI-1 Configuration + Environment coherence — find an env var omission that would silently degrade production without an error
scope: Adversarial framing: assume the operator deploys with PRODUCTION_ENV_TEMPLATE.env.txt copied verbatim, fills in only the OBVIOUS values (APP_KEY, DB_PASSWORD, fiscal secrets), and skips anything that 'looks optional'. What breaks SILENTLY (no boot crash, no 5xx, no operator-visible error) while real customers are being served?
method_note: RED-team perspective applied in-session sequentially. Each finding cross-checked against the boot guard list and the lazy-validation patterns documented by Architect + Security perspectives.

findings.summary: Five silent-degrade vectors identified. None catastrophically destroy V1 Le Cayenne single-domain cash-only deploy, but two would be operator-invisible until customer-impacting symptoms emerge: (1) FCM_SECRET_KEY vs FCM_SERVER_KEY naming drift between PROD template and config — push notifications silently no-op when V1.0.2 mobile activates, (2) BROADCAST_DRIVER=pusher with empty PUSHER_APP_KEY — boot guard passes, broadcasts silently 401, 30s polling fallback masks. Three additional vectors are dormant in V1 but ship-blocking for V2 SaaS B2B.

silent_degradation_vectors.trigger: Operator copies PRODUCTION_ENV_TEMPLATE.env.txt verbatim, sets FCM_SECRET_KEY=<actual_firebase_server_key>. V1.0.2 mobile push activation goes live.
silent_degradation_vectors.expected: FCM push notifications deliver to mobile clients
silent_degradation_vectors.actual: Silent no-op. FcmNotificationService reads config('services.fcm.server_key') → config/services.php:55 → env('FCM_SERVER_KEY', '') → empty string. Operator sees no error. Mobile clients receive zero pushes.
silent_degradation_vectors.primary_source_diff: PROD template uses FCM_SECRET_KEY, config/services.php expects FCM_SERVER_KEY. Variable name TYPO in the PROD template.
silent_degradation_vectors.current_v1_blast_radius: Zero — V1 Le Cayenne does NOT activate FCM mobile push (in-restaurant cash-only POS). Becomes customer-impacting the moment V1.0.2 mobile cycle ships.
silent_degradation_vectors.fix: Rename FCM_SECRET_KEY → FCM_SERVER_KEY at docs/cloud/PRODUCTION_ENV_TEMPLATE.env.txt:197. Same fix for FCM_TOPIC → FCM_TOPIC_PREFIX at line 198 (config/services.php:57).

silent_degradation_vectors.trigger: Operator sets BROADCAST_DRIVER=pusher (satisfies AppServiceProvider:193-198 guard which only checks driver != null) but leaves PUSHER_APP_KEY / PUSHER_APP_SECRET / PUSHER_APP_ID empty (e.g. forgot to migrate from staging values, or copy-paste error)
silent_degradation_vectors.expected: Real-time KDS/OSS broadcasts deliver to subscribed clients
silent_degradation_vectors.actual: Pusher SDK constructor accepts empty credentials. First broadcast triggers HTTP 401 from Pusher.com (or Soketi rejection). The Laravel queue worker retries 6 times (per .env.example:127 `--tries=6 --backoff=1,5,15,60,300`) then drops the broadcast. KDS/OSS surfaces fall back to the 30s polling (config/broadcasting.php:31-35) — operators see KDS update with a delay but no error. Silent real-time death.
silent_degradation_vectors.primary_source_gap: Guard checks driver name but NOT driver-specific credential completeness. driver='pusher' with empty keys passes the guard.
silent_degradation_vectors.current_v1_blast_radius: MEDIUM — Le Cayenne V1 ships with Soketi self-hosted (PROD template:53-61); same credential surface (PUSHER_APP_ID/KEY/SECRET point at Soketi). If operator misconfigures, real-time KDS delivery silently degrades to 30s polling. Cashiers see kitchen delay, customers may experience slow status updates.
silent_degradation_vectors.fix: Extend AppServiceProvider:193-198 guard: when driver IS 'pusher', also require non-empty PUSHER_APP_KEY/SECRET/ID. Same enforcement style as the existing 10 guards.

silent_degradation_vectors.trigger: Operator sets IDEMPOTENCY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED=true (satisfies the new Foundation Audit F-3 boot guard) but leaves IDEMPOTENCY_CACHE_STORE unset (config/idempotency.php:73 defaults to env('IDEMPOTENCY_CACHE_STORE')=null which falls back to cache.default at AppServiceProvider.php:52)
silent_degradation_vectors.expected: Idempotency lookups use Redis (cache.default in prod)
silent_degradation_vectors.actual: Falls back to cache.default → Redis IF CACHE_DRIVER=redis (which IS guarded). Safe in V1.0.X.
silent_degradation_vectors.current_v1_blast_radius: Zero in V1 — cache.default IS Redis by boot guard. Becomes a vector ONLY if a future deploy uses a non-Redis cache.default (forbidden by CACHE_DRIVER guard anyway).
silent_degradation_vectors.fix: No change needed — defense-in-depth via CACHE_DRIVER guard already covers this.

silent_degradation_vectors.trigger: Operator deploys multi-domain (admin.lecayenne.fr / kiosk.lecayenne.fr distinct from lecayenne.fr APP_URL) but forgets to set KIOSK_DOMAIN / ADMIN_DOMAIN env vars. APP_URL guard passes (APP_URL is set), but CORS allowed_origins array is missing entries for the other subdomains.
silent_degradation_vectors.expected: Kiosk browser hits admin API → CORS allows cross-origin
silent_degradation_vectors.actual: config/cors.php:6-10 array_filter([env('APP_URL'), env('KIOSK_DOMAIN'), env('ADMIN_DOMAIN')]) returns only [APP_URL]. The kiosk subdomain's preflight OPTIONS request silently 403s. /api/broadcasting/auth rejected — same silent real-time death as RED-2 but via CORS not credentials.
silent_degradation_vectors.primary_source_documentation_in_guard: // For kiosk/admin on distinct domains, also set KIOSK_DOMAIN and ADMIN_DOMAIN — config/cors.php allows all three.  (AppServiceProvider.php:188-189 — guard docstring mentions but does NOT enforce)
silent_degradation_vectors.current_v1_blast_radius: Zero — Le Cayenne V1 ships single-domain (lecayenne.fr). PROD template does NOT declare KIOSK_DOMAIN/ADMIN_DOMAIN (correct for single-domain).
silent_degradation_vectors.fix_v2: Future SaaS B2B multi-tenant deploys MUST set these. Recommend adding boot warning (not crash) when a domain ENV is set but doesn't match the kiosk/admin route prefix. Out of V1 scope.

silent_degradation_vectors.trigger: Operator sets STAFF_ONLY_MODE=true in prod .env. After `php artisan config:cache`, resources/views/master.blade.php reads env('STAFF_ONLY_MODE') which returns null (config:cache invalidates .env loading for non-config env() calls).
silent_degradation_vectors.expected: Customer self-service surfaces redirect to staff-only
silent_degradation_vectors.actual: STAFF_ONLY_MODE evaluates as falsy → customer surfaces remain open. Silent regression of the staff-only enforcement gate.
silent_degradation_vectors.evidence_quote_config: env('STAFF_ONLY_MODE') called via resources/views/master.blade.php — verified by `grep -rln STAFF_ONLY_MODE app/ resources/`
silent_degradation_vectors.evidence_quote_documented_anti_pattern: .env.example:23-24 + PROD template:187 STAFF_ONLY_MODE=true — declared but consumed via env() not config()
silent_degradation_vectors.current_v1_blast_radius: P2 — Le Cayenne V1 has STAFF_ONLY_MODE=true in PROD template:187. If config:cache hides the value, customer self-service surfaces (mobile/web) become accessible when owner intent is staff-only. Same Laravel anti-pattern as currency helpers (Architect finding).
silent_degradation_vectors.fix: Move STAFF_ONLY_MODE consumption to a config('app.staff_only_mode') read. V1.0.2 backlog.

silent_degradation_vectors.expected: Health endpoint full report (DB connection, queue depth, Redis ping) accessible only to LAN/monitoring
silent_degradation_vectors.actual: Full report publicly accessible. Reveals DB connection details, queue worker status, Redis ping. Attacker reconnaissance.
silent_degradation_vectors.evidence_quote: .env.example:216 + PROD template:108 default empty = no filter
silent_degradation_vectors.current_v1_blast_radius: LOW — endpoint behind APP_URL (HTTPS). PROD template:108 declares HEALTH_IPS_ALLOWED=127.0.0.1/32 explicitly. If operator follows template, OK.
silent_degradation_vectors.fix: Already mitigated by PROD template default — no change needed.

highest_asymmetry_finding.rationale: PROD template variable name typo (FCM_SECRET_KEY vs FCM_SERVER_KEY) is the ONLY finding where the operator can copy-paste the template verbatim and end up with a non-functional production feature with ZERO visible feedback. All other findings require the operator to actively make a mistake. This is a 1-line fix in a single doc file that prevents post-V1.0.2 push notification silent failure.
highest_asymmetry_finding.wave_h_continuity: Wave H heals (bug_001-bug_011) confirmed the pattern: silent fallback paths (role lookup, BranchScope withoutGlobalScope) are the highest-asymmetry bug class. RED-1 is the env-layer cousin: a name drift that produces a silent fallback to empty value.

p0_silent_attacks_explored_and_negated.scenario: Attacker forges /payment/stripe-webhook/ POST when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty
p0_silent_attacks_explored_and_negated.verdict: NEGATED — Stripe is not active in V1 Le Cayenne. Stripe gateway not wired into payment flow. Risk surfaces only if Stripe activated, at which point Security S-R3 applies.

p0_silent_attacks_explored_and_negated.scenario: Operator runs E2E_POS_USER / E2E_POS_PASS env values in production (.env.example:38-40 comments)
p0_silent_attacks_explored_and_negated.verdict: NEGATED — Comments are documentation only. No live consumer in app/. E2E_POS_PASS=admin@lecayenne.fr / 123456 hardcoded in reference_admin_e2e_creds memory is dev-only; production gets fresh seeded users.

p0_silent_attacks_explored_and_negated.scenario: FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET silently null after config:cache (per-branch override anti-pattern)
p0_silent_attacks_explored_and_negated.verdict: PARTIALLY NEGATED — global FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET still loads via config('fiscal.audit_secret'). Only the per-branch FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET_BRANCH_N override is silently inert. Chain still signs with global secret — graceful fallback per Architect P1 finding.

p0_silent_attacks_explored_and_negated.scenario: BACKUP_S3_BUCKET unset → scripts/backup-foodking-daily.sh silently skips upload
p0_silent_attacks_explored_and_negated.verdict: MITIGATED — script is bash, reads ${BACKUP_S3_BUCKET:-}; presumed to fail-loud or log. Out-of-scope (infra, not Laravel). PROD template:85 declares BACKUP_S3_BUCKET=foodking-backups-gra — operator-visible.

p0_silent_attacks_explored_and_negated.scenario: POS_FEATURED_CATEGORY_IDS empty CSV → all categories show on POS first page
p0_silent_attacks_explored_and_negated.verdict: INTENTIONAL FALLBACK — config/pos.php:58-61 comments: 'Empty list → fallback no filter (all categories shown — safe default when config not yet provisioned).' This is a deliberate degradation pattern, not a silent failure.

findings.verdict_red_team: AMBER — five silent-degrade vectors identified, two (FCM key drift + Pusher empty values) are operator-invisible. None are V1-Le-Cayenne ship blockers. RED-1 (FCM rename) is the highest-asymmetry 1-line doc fix worth landing pre-cloud. RED-2 (Pusher boot guard extension) is V1.0.2 hardening. RED-4 (multi-domain CORS) is V2 SaaS prep. Three escalation-quality issues + two informational.

recommendations.action: Fix FCM_SECRET_KEY → FCM_SERVER_KEY in PRODUCTION_ENV_TEMPLATE.env.txt:197 and FCM_TOPIC → FCM_TOPIC_PREFIX at line 198
Extend AppServiceProvider broadcast guard: when driver IS 'pusher', also require non-empty PUSHER_APP_KEY/SECRET/ID
Add boot warning when KIOSK_DOMAIN/ADMIN_DOMAIN set but don't match the kiosk/admin route prefix
Move STAFF_ONLY_MODE consumption to config('app.staff_only_mode') — eliminates env() in Blade anti-pattern + ensures config:cache safe
